Retry numerical estimation of its saturation, inhibition, and open square-root-branch parameters; the prior execution error was a missing-y input issue, so this fit explicitly uses only labeled training rows.

All observations use H=0.6 and fixed x_now/mem_conv, so a temporal fit is poorly identified; the verified bridge-to-siphon static mechanism directly explains the gradient and saturation response.
